tips.title: Abu: done
body: **Abu** before a verb says something has happened: **Abu anyam** (I have eaten), **Abu adiar** (I have finished).

tips.title: -it: long ago
body: The ending **-it** puts a verb in the past: **Alosit** I went, **Anyamit** I ate. **Ŋolo kaŋulu** is long ago.

culture.title: Stories of the past
body: Older Iteso tell of the migration from the north-east, from Karamoja, and of how families settled the land around the lakes.
